package dev.sora.protohax

import dev.sora.relay.compat.Color
import io.netty.buffer.Unpooled
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.v844.Bedrock_v844
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.BuildPlatform
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.skin.ImageData
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.skin.SerializedSkin
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.PlayerListPacket
import java.util.UUID

/** TEMPORARY - only injected into builds where java.awt.Color has been relocated (see DiagProbe). */
internal object DiagProbeAwt {

    fun execute() {
        DiagProbe.touch(Color::class.java)

        DiagProbe.step("compat Color has java.awt.Color semantics") {
            val a = Color(0x80102030.toInt(), true)
            val b = Color(0x102030)
            val c = Color(16, 32, 48)
            "argb=" + Integer.toHexString(a.getRGB()) + " alpha=" + a.getAlpha() +
                " r=" + a.getRed() + " g=" + a.getGreen() + " b=" + a.getBlue() +
                " | opaque(0x102030)=" + Integer.toHexString(b.getRGB()) +
                " | equals=" + (b == c) + " hash=" + (b.hashCode() == c.hashCode())
        }

        DiagProbe.step("PlayerListPacket with skin + colours round trip through the v844 codec") {
            val codec = Bedrock_v844.CODEC
            val helper = codec.createHelper()
            val skin = SerializedSkin.builder()
                .skinId("probe-skin")
                .playFabId("")
                .skinResourcePatch("{\"geometry\":{\"default\":\"geometry.humanoid.custom\"}}")
                .skinData(ImageData.of(64, 64, ByteArray(64 * 64 * 4)))
                .capeData(ImageData.EMPTY)
                .geometryData("")
                .premium(false)
                .fullSkinId("probe-skin-full")
                .color(Color(0xFF336699.toInt(), true))
                .trusted(true)
                .build()
            val entry = PlayerListPacket.Entry(UUID.randomUUID())
            entry.entityId = 42L
            entry.name = "probe"
            entry.xuid = ""
            entry.platformChatId = ""
            entry.buildPlatform = BuildPlatform.GOOGLE
            entry.skin = skin
            entry.isHost = false
            entry.isTrustedSkin = true
            entry.isSubClient = false
            entry.color = Color(0xFF00AA55.toInt(), true)
            val pkt = PlayerListPacket()
            pkt.action = PlayerListPacket.Action.ADD
            pkt.entries.add(entry)

            val buf = Unpooled.buffer()
            codec.tryEncode(helper, buf, pkt)
            val size = buf.readableBytes()
            val id = codec.getPacketDefinition(PlayerListPacket::class.java).id
            val back = codec.tryDecode(helper, buf, id) as PlayerListPacket
            val e = back.entries[0]
            "id=" + id + " bytes=" + size + " entries=" + back.entries.size + " name=" + e.name +
                " colour=" + Integer.toHexString(e.color.getRGB()) + " skinColour=" + Integer.toHexString(e.skin.color.getRGB())
        }
    }
}
